data_description.dataset_name: Gridded Population of the World Version 4 (GPWv4) Administrative Unit Center Points with Population Estimates

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global coverage of administrative unit center points with UN-adjusted population estimates and densities, spanning approximately 13.5 million input administrative units.

data_description.temporal_coverage: 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, and 2020; includes basic demographic characteristics (age and sex) for 2010.
data_description.records: Approximately 13.5 million administrative unit center points globally with population estimates, densities, land area, water area, and demographic attributes.
data_description.data_type_numeric: Numeric fields include population estimates, population density, land area, water area, and demographic breakdowns by age and sex.
data_description.important_note: This dataset represents population estimates at administrative unit centroids, not gridded population density. The estimates are adjusted to match UN World Population Prospects (WPP). Revision 11 is the latest version. The dataset requires hardware capable of handling large feature collections.
analytical_capabilities: Demographic structure analysis by age and sex

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Population count and density per administrative unit; land and water area in square kilometers.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Inspect property names for population fields, density, area, and demographic attributes before performing spatial aggregations or temporal comparisons.

data_description.data_source: NASA Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center (SEDAC), Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CIESIN), via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
